title: First page of the task list skips the oldest tasks
author: dana-fixture
body:
With 25 tasks in the board, `GET /tasks?page=1&pageSize=20` returns tasks 21 to 25 instead of tasks 1 to 20, and `page=2` returns nothing.

The README says pages are 1-based and the list is oldest first, so page 1 should start at the first task.

### Steps

1. Create 25 tasks.
2. Request `/tasks?page=1&pageSize=20`.

### Expected

Tasks 1 to 20, and a second page with tasks 21 to 25.

### Actual

Five tasks on page 1, none on page 2. The total count in the response is still 25.

comments.author: lee-fixture
comments.body: I can reproduce it. The web client hides it a little because it only ever asks for page 1, so the list just looks short.

comments.author: dana-fixture
comments.body: Whoever fixes this: please add a test for page 1 and for the last page. The existing page tests only check validation.
